_doc: Per-kind strengths of tools/assets/vivid.py (the world sprite regrade). vibrance: chroma boost of a flat-coloured pixel (C -> C(1 + v(1 - C/chroma_ref)): chroma_ref maps to itself, nothing passes it); depth: lightness taken off pale mid-to-high tones (L 45..85); contrast: local-contrast gain on L (L - blur(L)); contrast_limit: max |change| in L; warm_a/warm_b: CIELAB shift toward warm for non-neutral pixels (scaled by the strength); chroma_p95_cap is a hard limit (chroma above it is compressed until the sprite p95 fits) and value_floor too (L p5 may not fall below min(value_floor, the sprite own); the strengths scale down together if needed). world/ui: kind -> name globs, first match wins; never: names that are not regraded (characters, plates, sky, glow overlays).
